title: Brothers Reunited
next_chapter_hook: The night wind wailed, scattering the warmth of the campfire. Chen Nian's footsteps faded into the distance, yet his words echoed endlessly in Chen Ji's mind: No matter which path he chose, the Chen bloodline would forever endure. And at this moment, the will of the Heavenly Eye was gathering at the horizon—the final showdown that would rewrite destiny was about to begin.

text.content: Dawn broke, dyeing the horizon in a deathly pale. Chen Ji stood at the cliff's edge, gazing at the churning dark clouds in the distance—the materialized will of the Heavenly Eye, like an invisible giant eye overlooking this battlefield soon to become scorched earth. Su Qingyao's golden runes slowly formed at her fingertips—unique marks of the Fate Writer's bloodline. Once activated, they would rewrite karma at the cost of burning her own fortune. At this moment, she was using this near-self-destructive method to buy Chen Ji his final chance at victory.

But just then, a familiar aura came from behind. Chen Ji turned sharply to see a slightly frail figure approaching along the Mountain Path. The morning light outlined that person—thin features, seven-tenths resembling himself, but with the weathered weariness of years. Chen Nian—Chen Ji's long-lost sister, the woman who had been taken by the Holy Sect to serve as the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key'—was now standing before him, alive and real.

dialogue.content: (Furrowing brows) How are you here? The battlefield is extremely dangerous. I told you to stay in a safe place.

text.content: Chen Ji's tone was cold as iron, yet his gaze flickered the instant it touched Chen Nian's face. After all these years apart, his sister's temples had gained a few strands of premature white—that was the price of long-term bearing the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' curse. His fists unconsciously clenched, knuckles whitening. At this moment, the Tianji Record, the grand chess game of the world—all were thrown to the back of his mind. He only wanted to ensure that this girl, who had suffered so much, would never be hurt again.

dialogue.content: (Soft laugh) Brother, you haven't changed at all. Clearly worried sick, yet you insist on being tough. I'm not that little girl you used to shelter behind your back anymore. All these years... I've been getting stronger too.

text.content: As Chen Nian spoke, she slowly raised her right hand. On her palm rested an antique jade pendant emanating a faint glow—the Chen family's ancestral 'Heavenly Fate Decree,' a supreme treasure only activatable by direct bloodline. With it, even if the Heavenly Eye descended heavenly punishment, the Chen bloodline could briefly resist. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He remembered the vague prophecy in the Tianji Record: If blood-related kin use Heavenly Fate as the guiding thread, they can briefly shield against fate's gaze.

dialogue.content: (Low voice) You're using the Lock Key's power to activate it? Chen Nian, do you understand what this means? The Lock Key seal within your body will collapse, and then the Heavenly Eye will...

(Interrupting him) Will die, right? Brother, I already knew. The moment the Holy Sect took me away, I knew my fate. From that moment, I've been living for today—for the chance to witness you rewrite this damnable Heavenly Dao with my own eyes.

text.content: As her words fell, the mountain wind rose suddenly. There was not a trace of fear in Chen Nian's eyes, only an almost stubborn determination. That gaze made Chen Ji恍惚ly recall many years ago—when the Chen family had not yet fallen, young Chen Nian always followed behind him, saying in her childish voice 'Brother, I want to protect you too.' How many years had passed? He had always remembered those words, yet never imagined that one day, his sister would be the one to fulfill that childhood vow.

dialogue.content: (Smiling) You haven't changed, Brother. You're still that fool who swallows all hardships alone. These years in the Holy Sect, countless times at death's door, the only thought that kept me alive was—I must see you again, and tell you personally: No matter what choice you make, I'm on your side.

text.content: Chen Ji's Adam's apple slightly quivered; something threatened to spill from his eyes, but he forced it back. He was the Tianji Record's holder, a chess master who left nothing to chance, a man who would weave an unbreakable game in an era of upheaval where three major sects clashed, the Demonic Path invaded, and the Ancient Forbidden Land awakened—how could he cry? Yet when those eyes, identical to those in his memories, gazed at him, the heart wall he had built for years cracked in an instant.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's resolve left Chen Ji in a dilemma. He knew his sister's temperament—soft on the outside, unyielding within; once she decided, she would never turn back. But on the battlefield, the Heavenly Eye's gaze was like a thorn in the flesh, and he had to make a choice.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's power and, with Foresight, arrange a safe evacuation route in advance. Under cover of night, send Chen Nian out of the combat zone. No matter how she resists, preserve her life.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian safely departs; Chen Ji has no concerns holding him back
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may resent you for this, believing you deprived her of the right to choose

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and reached out to grasp Chen Nian's wrist. His movement was gentle, but his tone was firm: 'Xiao Nian, listen to me. After this battle, I'll come find you.'
A flash of disappointment crossed Chen Nian's eyes, quickly covered by a veil of tears. She didn't struggle, only gently squeezing Chen Ji's hand as she whispered: 'Brother... you always do this.'

choices.description: Respect Chen Nian's choice and face the impending decisive battle together with her. In the name of siblings, stand shoulder to shoulder against the Heavenly Eye, and together stride into this great crisis of life and death.
choices.visible_cost: Need to divert attention to protect Chen Nian during combat
choices.visible_reward: Siblings' bond resonates, possibly triggering the hidden skill 'Bloodline Inheritance'
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key' constitution may attract targeted strikes from the Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji gazed into his sister's eyes for a long moment, then suddenly smiled. That smile held helplessness, heartache, and more than anything, a sense of relief—he simply couldn't win against his stubborn sister.

"Alright." He released her hand and took a warm jade bottle from his sleeve—the very heirloom left by their mother, the 'Life-Sustaining Pill'. He pressed the elixir into Chen Nian's palm: "Keep it. Use it only in dire emergencies."

choices.description: Honestly tell Chen Nian the truth about his impending death, letting her leave as the Chen family's last bloodline. His fate was already sealed, and he refused to drag anyone else into it.
choices.visible_reward: May trigger Chen Nian's hidden storyline and obtain the key item 'Heavenly Fate Fragment'
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian might collapse from this, or she might be awakened to even greater power

text.content: Chen Ji turned his back to Chen Nian, voice hoarse: "Xiaonian, you should understand... The more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate. After this battle, I may not survive."

Soft sobs came from behind, but no cries. Chen Nian's voice was unexpectedly calm: "Brother, I know. From the day I first saw you, I knew. That's why I must stay—not to watch you die, but to witness your victory."

As night deepened, the siblings found a sheltered ravine and lit a campfire. Flames danced, illuminating two similar faces. In the distance, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's pressure blanketed the entire battlefield like something tangible, the air thick with imminent turmoil. Yet here, in this small refuge, the world seemed to quiet—just the crackling of burning wood and the long-awaited conversation between the siblings.

dialogue.content: Brother, do you remember when we were children? Every Mid-Autumn Festival, Mother would make osmanthus cakes, and you'd always share half of yours with me...

(A slight smile curves his lips) How old were you then? Just a tiny thing, couldn't even walk steadily, yet insisted on following right behind me. When you fell, you wouldn't cry—just stared at me with those eyes, waiting for me to pick you up.

text.content: Chen Nian burst out laughing, tears glistening at the corners of her eyes. That laugh rang clear as mountain spring water in the still night. Gazing at her profile, Chen Ji suddenly realized—this little shadow that always trailed behind him had somehow grown into a woman who could stand alone. All those years in the Holy Sect, the hardships and struggles—he knew nothing of them. But one thing he was certain: she hadn't been crushed by suffering. Like steel tempered in fire, her edge grew ever sharper.

dialogue.content: Brother, there's something I've always wanted to ask you. When the Chen family fell, you could have escaped much faster. Why did you risk coming back for me?

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent, his gaze fixed on the dancing flames. Memories flooded back like a tide—that night, the Chen estate blazed, screams echoing endlessly. He'd fled several miles, yet at the last moment turned back. With his crippled physique, he hacked through the Holy Sect's encirclement. In that battle, he suffered seven sword wounds, nearly dying. But whenever he wanted to give up, his sister's face appeared in his mind—that little girl who always followed behind him, calling 'Brother, wait for me.'

dialogue.content: (Softly) Because you're my sister. Is that reason enough?

text.content: Chen Nian's eyes instantly reddened. She said nothing, only slowly drew closer and rested her head on Chen Ji's shoulder. Just like when they were children—whenever she felt afraid or wronged, this was her way. Chen Ji didn't pull away; he merely tilted his head slightly so his sister could lean more comfortably. The campfire crackled, night wind howled past, yet in this moment, the siblings seemed transported back to those carefree days—when the Chen family still stood, parents were alive, and the scent of Mid-Autumn osmanthus filled the entire courtyard.

dialogue.content: Brother, tomorrow's battle... do you truly have confidence?

(With a light laugh) When have you ever seen me act without confidence? The Tianji Record grants me foresight—I've calculated every possibility of this battle countless times. The Heavenly Dao's Eye is powerful, but it has one fatal flaw—it is too arrogant.

text.content: As Chen Ji spoke, a sharp gleam flickered in his eyes. It was the light of a strategist, the wisdom and foresight bestowed by the Tianji Record. He continued: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye treats all seers throughout history as mere pieces on its board—the Tianji Record is merely one of its positioned pieces. But it has forgotten one thing—a piece can also turn against the player."

choice.prompt: Deep night fell, the campfire dimming. Chen Nian had fallen into a deep sleep against Chen Ji's shoulder, her breathing even and gentle. Gazing at his sister's peaceful sleeping face, an indescribable emotion surged within Chen Ji. Tomorrow would be the final battle—he needed to make final preparations. But before that, there was one thing he must confirm.

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's final foresight ability to confirm that every detail of tomorrow's battle is flawless. Even if it consumes precious Heavenly Fate, ensure the plan has no omissions.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the 'Omniscient View' state, obtaining one near-death avoidance opportunity in tomorrow's battle
choices.risk_hint: Excessive use of the Tianji Record may intensify the deadly backlash of fate

text.content: Chen Ji gently set Chen Nian down and took out the incomplete Tianji Record from his chest. The yellowed pages gleamed with a faint light under the moonlight, as if whispering something. He took a deep breath and pressed his palm onto the pages.

In an instant, a golden light surged from the Tianji Record, and Chen Ji's pupils reflected countless intertwined images—fragments of the future, the direction of destiny. His consciousness was pulled into chaos, rapidly calculating every possibility.

choices.description: Awaken the sleeping Mo Xiansheng on the first page of the Tianji Record, consulting this soul guardian who knows the complete truth of the Tianji Record. Perhaps key information about the weaknesses of the Heavenly Eye can be obtained.
choices.visible_cost: Consume one opportunity for Mo Xiansheng's guidance
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a crucial item 'Tianji Fragment · Final Chapter' fragment. Collecting all fragments will unlock the complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's answers are often profound, potentially sparking new uncertainties about the upcoming battle

text.content: Chen Ji bit his fingertip, letting a drop of blood fall onto the Tianji Record's cover. The blood was swiftly absorbed by the pages, and an ancient, translucent figure gradually emerged from the book—a manifestation of Mo Xiansheng.
Mo Xiansheng's form appeared indistinct, on the verge of vanishing. Yet when his ethereal gaze met Chen Ji's, a glimmer of approval flickered: 'Well done, child. What would you like to ask?'

choices.description: Abandoning all preparations, he stayed by Chen Nian's side until dawn. Regardless of tomorrow's outcome, tonight he only wanted to be an ordinary brother, protecting his sister's peaceful sleep.
choices.visible_reward: Sibling bond reaches maximum, unlocking the hidden passive 'Bloodline Protection': When Chen Nian is present, all fatal damage targeting Chen Ji is reduced by 30%
choices.risk_hint: May fall into a passive position at the start of battle due to insufficient preparation

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record back into his chest, without using any foresight abilities. He sat quietly, watching his sister's peaceful sleeping face. Moonlight bathed her in a silvery glow.

Memories flooded through him—taking her to catch fireflies as children, her brave face when she scraped her knee, the heartbreaking cry when the Holy Sect took her away. These moments carved themselves into his heart, becoming the driving force that helped him endure countless desperate situations.

The night wind gradually stilled, and a pale light emerged in the eastern sky. Chen Nian slowly awakened, noticing her brother sat beside her in the same position, with faint dark circles under his eyes. Her heart ached, realizing Chen Ji had likely stayed awake all night.

dialogue.content: (Softly) Brother, you stayed up all night again.
(With a gentle smile) I'm used to it. Besides... watching you sleep peacefully is more restful than my own sleep.

text.content: Chen Nian's nose tingled, her eyes reddening. She abruptly sat up, cradling Chen Ji's face in her hands, and earnestly declared: 'Brother, listen to me. Regardless of today's outcome, no matter what path you choose—the Chen family's bloodline will endure forever. You are part of it, and so am I.'

dialogue.content: (Voice trembling yet resolute) Brother, I've brought some Chen family veterans. Few in number, but all devoted warriors who once followed our father. Though their cultivation is modest, their loyalty is unwavering. This battle, we face together.

text.content: Chen Ji looked at his sister's resolute eyes, and warmth surged in his heart. This sister who once needed his protection had now become his strength in reverse. He suddenly recalled what Mo Xiansheng had said: "The true power of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in gathering hearts." Indeed, without his years of careful planning and gradual accumulation, how could he possess the capital to rival the Heavenly Eye today?

choice.prompt: A dull war drum echoed from the distance, the moment of final battle approaching. Chen Ji's Tianji Record trembled slightly, heralding the accelerating condensation of the Heavenly Eye's will. Time was running out—and at the crucial moment, Chen Nian spoke the words she had long harbored in her heart.

choices.description: Seriously receive the "Heavenly Mandate" from Chen Nian, acknowledging her identity as a comrade-in-arms. The siblings unite, displaying the Chen family bloodline's unyielding will before Heaven.
choices.visible_cost: Distracted by protecting Chen Nian during combat
choices.visible_reward: Upon activation of "Heavenly Mandate," Chen Ji gains 15% damage reduction; Chen Nian gains 30% of Chen Ji's attribute bonus
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's "Heavenly Mandate Key" constitution may become a priority target for the Heavenly Eye's strikes

text.content: Chen Ji extended his hand and solemnly received the Heavenly Mandate carrying the Chen family's fortune. The Jade Pendant was warm and smooth in his palm, as if still retaining his sister's body temperature. He gripped it tightly and said in a low voice: "Good. This battle, we siblings face together."

Finally a tear rolled down from Chen Nian's eye socket, yet a brilliant smile bloomed at the corner of her lips. That smile carried relief, anticipation, and a kind of resolute determination after breaking free from a cocoon.

choices.text: Send Her Off on Her Final Journey
choices.description: At the final moment before the decisive battle begins, forcibly open a temporal rift with the power of the Tianji Record, sending Chen Nian to a safe secret realm. No matter how she cries or begs, give her no chance to refuse.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian safely evacuated, Chen Ji gains "Last Stand" state: all attributes increased by 50%, but death is certain after battle
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may never forgive your autocratic decision

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate again. He forcefully activated the Tianji Record, and the golden runes on the fragment suddenly illuminated. A pitch-black rift silently tore open behind Chen Nian. That was a temporal passage leading to a safe secret realm.

Chen Nian widened her eyes in astonishment, her voice changing pitch: "Brother! What are you doing!" She struggled desperately, yet found herself being pushed toward the edge of the rift by a gentle but irresistible force.

choices.text: Speak Last Words and Fight Shoulder to Shoulder
choices.description: Be honest with Chen Nian about everything, including that you long ago prepared yourself for death. Then stand shoulder to shoulder with her, welcoming the coming decisive battle with the worst expectations.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian's affection and trust greatly increased, potentially triggering the hidden effect "Shared Destiny"
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may have her combat state affected by excessive grief

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a move that surprised Chen Nian—he gently embraced her. The hug was tight, forceful, as if he wanted to merge his sister into his very bones and blood.

"Little Nian, listen to me." His voice was very soft, yet every word was crystal clear: "If I don't return from this battle, you must live on in my stead. The Chen family's bloodline, Chen Ji's will—these must be carried forward by you."

Before the words even finished, the sky suddenly changed color. That invisible giant eye seemed to sense something, its oppressive might suddenly multiplying several times over. The air was filled with a suffocating pressure. The distant war drums grew more urgent, as the allied forces of the three great sects had begun to form ranks, and the shadow of the Demonic Path also stirred restlessly. The entire battlefield was like a pot of oil about to boil over—only needing one final spark to explode.

Chen Nian's tears finally burst forth, but she did not cry out. She only tightly gripped Chen Ji's hand, her grip so forceful that her knuckles turned white. She knew she could not change her brother's decision, just as she could not stop him from turning back to save her all those years ago. But at least for this moment, she could still stand by his side.

dialogue.content: "No matter which path you choose, Brother... the Chen Family bloodline will endure forever. As long as I live, our parents' spirit lives on. And you... you were never alone."

text.content: "Dawn finally pierced through the clouds, golden sunlight pouring down to illuminate this battlefield soon to be stained with blood. Chen Ji gazed at the rolling dark clouds in the distance, feeling his sister's warmth in his palm, a faint serene smile curving his lips. How many years had it been? From atrash disciple to a strategist who never missed a scheme, from standing alone to now having a sister beside him willing to die for him—along this journey, he had lost too much, yet gained equally as much. So what if there was a Heavenly Dao's Eye? So what if fate demanded its inevitable backlash? As long as there were people he wished to protect, he possessed the courage to play against Heaven."

"He slowly drew the sword at his waist, its blade gleaming with icy cold light under the sun. Behind him, Chen Nian's Heavenly Mandate hummed, resonating with the Tianji Record within his body. An unprecedented power flowed between the siblings—that was the power of bloodline, the power of bond—and more importantly, the power to defy destiny. 'Come then.' he murmured, his gaze fixed直视那只高高在上的天眼，'这一局，我陈机接了。'"
